correctness.rationale: For each integer partition of the ambient equivalence-class capacities, the sorted demand-capacity criterion is an if-and-only-if embedding condition. Factorial-weight enumeration counts all labeled induced partitions; Stirling decomposition counts all tuple atomic diagrams; all diagrams are independent and isolable by quantifier-free formulas, giving exactly 2^T_k definable relations. Stirling inversion and the n^k growth term prove recovery of cardinality and b_r. Tables for all nondegenerate class-size partitions on at most five points prove the sharp n=4 unlabeled and n=5 labeled cutoffs. Direct tuple-level tests of 44 small partitions and 626590 assignments confirm the finite computations; no infinite claim relies solely on enumeration.

value.rationale: The exact all-arity definability counts are a natural numerical compression of quantifier-free expressive power. A complete formula makes the inverse question meaningful rather than an arbitrary finite search. The theorem isolates the sharp first nontrivial failure at five points, uniquely classifies its pair, and contrasts it with the strictly earlier unlabeled age-profile failure at four. This determines a concrete boundary of two established invariants and gives an explicit semantic loss (existence of a three-element class), a motivated mathematical classification despite no downstream theorem being asserted.
